title: Dettaglio Flusso e Drilldown Sessione
description: Vista di dettaglio su flussi, step e azioni annidate per indagini operative.

viz_flusso_table.title: Flussi (clic su una riga per il drilldown)

options.query:
index=dtrum sourcetype="dtrum:emissionevct:flusso" version=2
| search flussoId="$tok_flusso_id$"
| spath path=steps{} output=step_obj
| mvexpand step_obj
| spath input=step_obj path=stepIndex output=step_index
| spath input=step_obj path=stepLabel output=step_label
| search step_index="$tok_step_index$"
| spath input=step_obj path=actions{} output=action_obj
| mvexpand action_obj
| spath input=action_obj path=seq output=action_seq
| spath input=action_obj path=sessionId output=action_session_id
| spath input=action_obj path=actionType output=action_type
| spath input=action_obj path=actionKey output=action_key
| spath input=action_obj path=startTime output=action_start_ms
| spath input=action_obj path=duration output=action_duration_ms
| eval action_seq=tonumber(action_seq), action_duration_ms=tonumber(action_duration_ms)
| eval action_start=strftime(action_start_ms/1000, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
| table flussoId step_index step_label action_seq action_session_id action_type action_key action_start action_duration_ms
| sort 0 action_seq

index=dtrum sourcetype="dtrum:emissionevct:flusso" version=2
| search userId="$tok_user_id$" flussoId="$tok_flusso_id$"
| rename "sessionIds{}" as sessionIds
| eval session_count=mvcount(sessionIds)
| table _time flussoId userId completed abandoned maxStep nSteps durationSeconds activeSeconds deadTimeSeconds totalErrors hasError session_count browserType country city
| sort 0 - _time

index=dtrum sourcetype="dtrum:emissionevct:flusso" version=2
| search flussoId="$tok_flusso_id$"
| spath path=steps{} output=step_obj
| mvexpand step_obj
| spath input=step_obj path=actions{} output=action_obj
| mvexpand action_obj
| spath input=action_obj path=sessionId output=session_id
| spath input=action_obj path=startTime output=action_start_ms
| stats count as action_events min(action_start_ms) as first_event_ms max(action_start_ms) as last_event_ms by session_id
| eval first_event=strftime(first_event_ms/1000, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
| eval last_event=strftime(last_event_ms/1000, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
| table session_id action_events first_event last_event
| sort 0 - action_events

index=dtrum sourcetype="dtrum:emissionevct:flusso" version=2
| search flussoId="$tok_flusso_id$"
| spath path=steps{} output=step_obj
| mvexpand step_obj
| spath input=step_obj path=stepIndex output=step_index
| spath input=step_obj path=stepLabel output=step_label
| spath input=step_obj path=pagina output=step_page
| spath input=step_obj path=actionCount output=step_action_count
| spath input=step_obj path=firstStartTime output=step_first_start_ms
| spath input=step_obj path=lastEndTime output=step_last_end_ms
| search step_index="$tok_step_index$"
| eval step_first_start=strftime(step_first_start_ms/1000, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
| eval step_last_end=strftime(step_last_end_ms/1000, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
| table flussoId userId step_index step_label step_page step_action_count step_first_start step_last_end
| sort 0 step_index
